## Communication between Athlete and Spotter

Communication is a shared responsibility. Before beginning a set, the spotter(s) and athlete should establish and communicate how initial bar movements will occur, the intended number of repetitions, and signals for moving the bar into position. If the spotters do not have this information, they may take control of the bar improperly, too soon, or too late, and consequently disrupt the exercise or injure the athlete or themselves.
